comparison.objective: Power on a bench supply and set its voltage knob from 12 V to 9 V.
comparison.physical_skill: Press a latching button, grasp and rotate an exposed knob precisely, release it, and avoid disturbing adjacent controls.
comparison.success_condition: Supply is on, voltage is within 0.2 V of 9 V, other knobs remain within 3 degrees, unit stays in place, and arms retreat for 1 second.
comparison.reason: This is the closest exposed-control task, but it lacks recessed hex insertion, captive-screw loosening/relocking, moving-socket reacquisition, and iterative physical-response testing under energy and force limits.
